verdict.rationale: v0 documents isolated working branches and preview deployments built from those branches. That lets users test changes in a non-production deployment before publishing to the production URL, which is real environment-level isolation for code rather than a mere dry-run. However, nothing shows the preview environment uses separate data, databases, or credentials. Environment variables and integrations are shared at the Project level, so separation from production data is unproven. Missing for 10: documented data isolation for previews (separate databases or environment variables per environment), an explicit sandbox mode for agent testing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Preview deployments are built from working branches.
work on isolated branches, preview changes, run CI, and publish through pull requests
